chitchat: Ma Cinder stirs the pot and watches the flats over your shoulder.
"Water's life out here. Don't waste mine."
"Camp's full. Doesn't mean you're welcome to stay."
description: The matriarch of the Slake Pond camp: sun-cured, iron-grey, and entirely without illusions. She has buried more of her people than she'll say and guards the living with a pragmatism that shades into menace.

accepted.text: "They den in the wet ground — the Seep, the Rust Marsh, the Runoff down south. Two at least. And mind your footing; the tar doesn't give anything back."

bye.text: "Fill your jug and move on, then."

quest_offer.text: "Something's coming up out of the seeps — tar-things, big and slow and hungry. Took two of mine this week. Put a couple of them down and there's water, food, and goodwill in it. Goodwill's worth more than it sounds out here."

reported.text: "...The seeps are quieter. My people noticed. Here — clean water and a hot meal, and you're welcome at this fire, which is more than most get."

root.text: A leather-faced woman looks up from a cook-pot, one hand never far from a length of pipe. "This is my pond, my camp, my water. State your business or fill your jug and go."

clothing_layers: a patched canvas duster hung with tools
layered wool gone the colour of ash

name: Ma Cinder
